scope: Structural comparison of selected upstream function, class and callable declarations, including generation, provider requests, tokenizers, settings, modules, regex, Lua, triggers, lorebook and data helpers, reversing injected ports to their source-local names and declared expression ports to their original mutations. Ignores export modifiers, parentheses, equivalent object-key/shorthand notation, regex flag order and the explicitly migrated DBState notification branch and declared module-loader ports. The statistics/activity ports deliberately change native persistence and require separate behavioral tests; Lua invocation cleanup/error policies and Google streaming UTF-8/SSE and pipe-error policies are explicit, hash-pinned exceptions reported separately from originalAlgorithmPreserved, with behavioral tests. All selected declarations remain compared; this comparison does not prove their bindings, complete native-host integration, providers or browser compatibility.
